description: This file defines the TextNode class in the Twig templating engine, representing a text node within the template AST. It includes methods for constructing the node and compiling it into PHP code.

classes.name: TextNode
classes.description: Represents a textual node in a Twig template, capable of compiling itself into executable PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TextNode object with the given data string and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the TextNode into PHP code that renders the text when executed.
